name: Pokoge ~Touhou Shisetsudan Ryoujokuki~
original_name: ポコゲー ～東方使節団凌辱記～
source:
There is a man who is no longer a human due to his tentacle body. He has a human heart, but hideous habits acquired during centuries. He acquires tremendous power and demands to be called "King of Tentacles". Women become his play things. One day a ship arrives from the far east country. There is one thing that interests him in women missionaries in foreign clothes - how do they cry?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/04/vn-of-month-december-2006-kimi-no-koe.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
有一名男子因触手般的身体而不再是人类。他仍有人类之心，却保有数百年间形成的可憎习性。他获得巨大力量，要求被称作“触手之王”。女性成了他的玩物。某天，一艘船从遥远的东方国度抵达。他对身穿异国服饰的女传教士只有一个兴趣：她们会如何哭泣？

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/04/vn-of-month-december-2006-kimi-no-koe.html]vndbreview[/url]]
